title: Cancelling a Scheduled Closing (Closing and Funding)
content:
**Rule.** Only the borrower can cancel a scheduled Closing and Funding closing for their own reasons; the system cancels it when the loan file is withdrawn or denied. A closing that has been signed cannot be cancelled: a rescindable transaction ends only by rescission, and any other signed transaction proceeds to funding. Cancellation stamps the closing's closed date and voids any drawn package without a redraw fee.

| Closing status | Who can end it by cancellation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| scheduled | the borrower, or the system when the file is withdrawn or denied | cancelled; closed date stamped |
| documents out | the borrower, or the system when the file is withdrawn or denied | cancelled; drawn package voided without a redraw fee; closed date stamped |
| signed, rescindable | no one; it ends only by rescission | not cancellable |
| signed, not rescindable | no one; it proceeds to funding | not cancellable |

Hypothetical: a borrower who cancels after the package is drawn but before signing pays no redraw fee for the voided package.
